references.label: Double Bonus saucer
references.description: Collect the upper-right Double Bonus saucer when it lights.

references.label: Drop-target bank
references.description: Let safe or incidental drop-target hits add bonus. Do not force a direct bank shot.

references.label: Lit bumper
references.description: Keep the ball in the upper playfield and use the lit bumper to build bonus. Collect Double Bonus at the upper-right saucer. Shoot drop targets only when their rebounds are safe.
